<div class="card-body">
'''Mournful Roar''' is a [[Dark]] [[Effect]] ([[Immediate Effect]]) from [[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">悲しみの雄叫び</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">ハンがロストするか行方不明になった直後にチューイーに配備する。相手は「ウーキーに勝たせてやれ」と「ウーキーの雄叫び」を使用できない。また相手は各プレイヤーのターンの終わりに1フォースを失う。ハンが再び配備されるか発見されたなら、このエフェクトはキャンセルされる。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-Mournful-Roar-PSA-89232351.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">ハンを失うと考えただけで、チューバッカの心は引き裂かれそうになった。その雄叫びは悲痛に満ちていた。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Mournful Roar.

'''Card text:'''
Deploy on Chewie just after Han is lost or goes missing. The opponent cannot use Let The Wookiee Win or Wookiee Roar. The opponent also loses 1 Force at the end of each player’s turn. Cancel this Effect if Han is deployed again or found.

'''Lore:'''
The thought of losing Han nearly tore Chewbacca’s heart apart. His roar was full of anguish.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese lore says the thought of losing Han nearly tore Chewbacca’s heart apart.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Mournful Roar]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
